_source_note: THE ONLY EXTERNALLY-SOURCED CASE IN THE CORPUS. This is a real defect from a live product (AI-Chatbot-Widget-SaaS), found by hand-reading the repository BEFORE guardian existed and before this rule set could see it. Its correct answer was established by a human, independently of the system now being graded against it. Every other case here was authored by the same process that produced guardian - see corpus/README.md. Keep this marked `external` until there is a second one.
purpose: The filter IS present - .eq("id", companyId) - and the value comes from an unauthenticated request body, on an endpoint serving any origin through a service-role client. The presence rule passes this file. Only provenance catches it.
